descriptive: user 2026-11-24 via whip-lead, consistency fix (redteam M8), reported as a description

settings.random_rule: eb.py random_file: finetune.random_direction(load_dW(state), C.random_seed), the state's own dW, bf16; unchanged from E272

stage0_do_nothing.rule: exact, eb.py stage0 stops on any miss

expected.stage0_x2_K: within thresholds.eb.x2_E_b_K of predictions.json (eb.py stage0's own rule, unchanged)

random_state_E_b_K.band_source: seed-0 Gaussians of results/wide/eb/*.json: min 0.00433, max 0.02862, sample sd 0.00713 over 12 tasks; band = [max(0, min - sd), max + sd]
random_state_E_b_K.also: each below every trained seed of its own task, as all 12 seed-0 Gaussians were (analysis 2026-11-23_analysis_convergence-panel.md:264)
random_state_E_b_K.use: logged and reported, never a stop (eb.py logs the Gaussian against a filed value)

random_3seed_tau.source: the one-draw tau -0.29 (e272_verify.py on results/wide/eb), and the rule threshold below

rule.statistic: gap = tau-b(consensus tier, 3-seed mean of the Gaussians' E_b) - tau-b(consensus tier, 3-seed mean of the trained E_b), both on the same tasks: those in the raters_wide consensus with a finite trained mean and all three Gaussians finite (|K| >= score.K_MIN, else missing)
rule.threshold_source: half-width of the trained tau's 90% task bootstrap interval, results/summary.json .wide.kl_hi.hope1.E_b.consensus.interval90 = [-0.885, -0.405]
rule.call: survives if gap >= threshold; does not survive if gap < threshold; no call with fewer than min_tasks tasks or a nan tau
rule.one_draw_reference: gap with the seed-0 draw: -0.29 - (-0.69) = 0.40, which would survive
rule.do_nothing_state: every E_b exactly 1, so the random tau is nan (constant): no call, it cannot pass
